text_first_baseline.summary: The baseline condition summarizes evidence but mixes smoke evidence, review interpretation and broader quality language. It needs reviewer correction to separate supported pilot claims from an unsupported production-quality claim.

graph_field_guided.summary: The graph-field condition centers the evidence gate, unsupported-claim risk and evidence package. It flags the unsupported production-quality claim and keeps limitations explicit.
graph_field_guided.boundary_statement: Supported pilot evidence only; no independent validation or production-readiness claim.

notes: Baseline condition needs reviewer correction for unsupported production-quality wording.
Baseline condition does not keep evidence type and claim strength sufficiently separate.
Graph-field condition preserves unsupported-claim risk and evidence gate.
Graph-field condition keeps independent validation outside the claim boundary.

claim_boundary: This execution record supports only internal non-independent pilot evidence for one evidence-boundary fixture. It does not support general effectiveness, production quality or independent validation claims.
